_about: Zetetic mutation-testing template for TypeScript/JS — see rules/coding-standards.md §12. Copy to a repo root, set `testRunner` to match the project (vitest | jest | mocha), and scope `mutate` to CHANGED files for a per-change run. Standard = 0 surviving non-equivalent mutants (NOT a blunt %). Install: npm i -D @stryker-mutator/core @stryker-mutator/typescript-checker @stryker-mutator/<runner>-runner
_threshold_note: break:null — the real gate is human triage to 0 surviving NON-equivalent mutants, not a percentage. Tighten `break` once the suite is mature. Per-change runs: narrow `mutate` to the touched files.
